title: November 2026 owner-authorized Mainnet anchor on a fresh EvidenceRegistry (V1) instance

ownerAuthorization.verbatimQuoteAr: اعمل على الشبكة الرئيسية ع طول انا بديك الصلاحية
ownerAuthorization.verbatimQuoteEn: Work on the main network right away — I am giving you the authorization
ownerAuthorization.decision: anchor directly on Core Mainnet; supersedes the earlier owner note "بس بعد مانخلص الاختبار الاول" ("only after we finish the first test"), which had ordered a testnet-first attempt
ownerAuthorization.scope: on-chain anchoring of the CoreGuard evidence receipt on Core Mainnet (chainId 1116), using the owner-funded deployer key
ownerAuthorization.keyHandling: the deployer private key was read from the local .env at broadcast time and was never printed, logged, or committed

registry.deployScript: script/Deploy.s.sol (forge script --legacy --broadcast; vm.startBroadcast wrapper added after the first run proved simulation-only)

firstAttemptNote: the first forge run executed WITHOUT --broadcast: forge reported 'No transactions to broadcast' and the address it printed (0xC7f2Cf4845C6db0e1a1e91ED41Bcd0FcC1b0E141) was a simulation artifact that never received code. No gas was spent on it. The real, confirmed deployment is the 0x86da…4974 instance above.

commitIntent.note: the intentId is the receiptId itself — scripts/verify-anchor.ps1 compares the IntentCommitted event topic1 against the receiptId, so the receipt identity is what commitIntent binds

commitmentSource: scripts/compute-commitment.mjs over examples/transfer/receipt-valid.json (planned artifact committed as scripts/live-anchor-planned.json); both txs were eth_call-simulated successfully before each broadcast

resultVocabulary.recorded: anchorProof carried result=1 (= VALID under the anchor-verdict vocabulary)
resultVocabulary.v2CommentNote: contracts/EvidenceRegistryV2.sol's enum comment lists VALID=0 — that comment is legacy and unenforced; V1 only checks result <= 2. This fixture follows the anchor-verdict vocabulary, so result=1 means VALID here.

verdict.verifier: scripts/verify-anchor.ps1 -Level L2 (three-proofs verifier: A deployment, B commitment, C independent offline recompute)

optionalChecks.B_storageAnchor: NOT_RUN — the verifier's frozen storage-slot constant is specific to the September proofId, so the November slot is not derivable from it; integrity is instead proven via canonical event topics + cross-provider readbacks

verdict.txBlockBinding: PASS (eth_getTransactionByHash vs receipt.blockHash; txHash and blockHash are distinct fields)
verdict.artifactNote: scripts/verify-live.regenerated.json is the live verdict artifact; it is gitignored, so its values are copied into this committed fixture

crossRpc.method: verifyCommitment(proofId, commitment) + verifyCommitment(receiptId-as-intentId, commitment) + isCommitted(proofId) + isCommitted(receiptId) re-issued on both providers — all returned true
crossRpc.providerNotes: rpc.ankr.com/core now requires an API key (error -32053) and core.publicnode.com was unreachable; both were excluded and the two working independent providers were used

receiptBoundary.honestNote: the anchored receipt is the in-tree synthetic demo receipt, not a live counterparty transaction. It declares chainId 1114 (Testnet2), and it was anchored on Mainnet 1116 for permanence — a deliberate cross-chain persistence choice, recorded here so nobody later mistakes the anchor for Mainnet-executed payment evidence.

septemberRegistriesUntouched.note: both September instances remain exactly as they were (isCommitted on the V2 registry reverts for V1-shaped ids and its September records stay frozen). V2 requires EIP-712 per-call signatures (domain CoreGuardRegistry, digest via its commitIntentDigest/anchorProofDigest views) and no signing helper exists in this tree, so the November anchor used a fresh V1 instance instead of touching frozen evidence.

honesty.verifiedNotSafe: VERIFIED ≠ SAFE — the L2 verdict proves anchor integrity only (a specific commitment is on-chain and independently recomputed); it is NOT execution truth, NOT a security audit, and NOT external review. VERIFIED is reachable and may still coexist with UNKNOWN.
honesty.noOutcomePromises: no funding, partnership, incubation, or adoption outcome is promised anywhere in public content
honesty.testCountsNeverHeadline: test counts are reproducibility context, never the headline claim
